Survey was conducted with 3 Saildrone USVs as opposed to a research vessel. There was no biological data collection from the USVs, so krill lengths from 2018 are used to scale backscatter into abundance. These USVs only collected data to 200 m (as opposed to 500 m during vessel-based surveys). Based on other survey years, a mean of 4.3% of total observed krill backscatter was observed > 200m. No correction is currently applied for this, although one was initially used. See Levine and De Robertis 2025 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fishres.2025.107270) for discussion.
